Journal, single stable source ID, verified for 2016-2025 (10y default window); 2026 partial data present (139 works so far). Identity, year coverage, affiliation coverage (100% on 25-work sample), and institution sniff test all pass cleanly. Volume note: 2016-2020 type:article counts (139-168/yr) run 16-31% below expected_per_year floor of 200, while 2021-2025 (222-312/yr) is comfortably in range [200,400] -- reads as real historical growth in TRO output, not a data problem; registry owner may want to consider widening expected_per_year (e.g. to [130,400]) but that's a methodology call outside worker scope.

venues.display: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
venues.notes: ICRA is mostly NOT fragmented into per-year OpenAlex sources unlike ISSCC/DAC/IEDM. Only 2022 (S4363607759) is OpenAlex-native (confirmed by direct DOI resolution); all other 2016-2025 years are orphaned in OpenAlex (works exist, ingested via Crossref, but primary_location.source is null - verified via DOI lookup) and are covered via Crossref DOI-prefix validation (10.1109/icra<opt-digits>.<year>.<paper>). S4210217939 is a legit legacy ICRA series source but covers only 2007 (out of window) - kept for completeness/future backfill, unused by current 2016-2025 harvest. REJECTED S4306419799 ('International Conference on Robotics and Automation' catch-all, 698 works spanning 1984-2021, 8-61/yr) as contaminated with unrelated papers - do not use for harvesting; flagged for human review. Rejected lookalikes: ICRAI, AQTR, ICORAS, ICCAR, CCRA, ICMRA, ICARCV, CACRE, ROBOTHIA, ICARA. 2016-2018/2022 volumes run 21-42% below expected_per_year[1200,2000] lower bound but this matches ICRA's real accepted-paper growth over the decade, not a wrong-source signal (identity confirmed via DOI registrant prefix + content sampling). 2026: zero genuine ICRA works found (all apparent hits were the distinct ICRAI lookalike) - not included, unclear if lag or not-yet-held.

venues.notes: Identity confirmed with high confidence: Crossref DOI prefix 10.15607 is registered exactly to 'Robotics: Science and Systems Foundation' (no lookalike ambiguity; Science Robotics and regional robotics symposia checked and excluded). RSS does NOT fragment into per-year OpenAlex sources like IEDM/DAC/ISCA -- it has essentially no usable OpenAlex source at all. Two name-matching sources exist and were both rejected: S4306420803 (conference, 29 stray DOI-less works scattered 2006-2020, ~2% of true output, unusable/double-counting risk) and S4393918458 (journal, correct ISSN 2330-7668, but 0 works attached). All ~1,469 real papers live in OpenAlex only as orphaned records (primary_location.source=null), reachable by DOI, not by source filter. Year coverage 2016-2025 fully confirmed via Crossref with DOI-prefix-verified per-year counts (see years{}), volume within/near expected_per_year [70,170] except 2016 (47, below range but at window edge). 2026 checked, not yet published (0 hits). Set to candidate, not verified, for an affirmative, venue-specific reason (not the 85%-on-native-years technicality, which would just be skipped): Crossref's RSS records have 0% author affiliation strings (unlike IEDM, nothing for normalize_affiliations.py to resolve later), and the only fallback -- OpenAlex's orphaned records -- has only ~45-50% institution coverage, inconsistent per paper (0/N to N/N), the same pattern PLAN.md already tested and rejected project-wide. Institution attribution, this project's core purpose, is not yet solvable for RSS with the current pipeline design. Needs a user decision before harvesting: accept degraded orphaned-record coverage, find a third data source (Semantic Scholar, official RSS site), or exclude RSS pending better data. Full detail in data/reports/rss-2026-07-21.md.

10-year sweep (2016-2025) complete 2026-07-19. Rule: try OpenAlex source first, Crossref fallback if absent -- no attempt to model *why* a year is missing from OpenAlex, that turned out not to matter and not to be reliably predictable (an 'orphaned rich record' path was investigated and abandoned: institution-resolution on OpenAlex work records lacking a source link was inconsistent, sometimes fully resolved, sometimes empty, not worth building around). Only 2021 and 2022 have real OpenAlex per-year sources (both checklist-verified: 2021 89.2% affiliation coverage, 2022 92.4%, both PASS, top institutions IMEC/TSMC/CAS/Samsung/IBM-tier as expected). All other years (2016-2020, 2023-2025) confirmed absent from OpenAlex, present in Crossref with DOI-prefix-verified counts -- see years{} below. Per-year DOI prefixes are NOT constant across years (IEEE reassigns them each edition), so a single venue-level doi_prefix field doesn't work; each Crossref year needs its own. Status stays candidate, not verified: the Crossref years are identity+volume+affiliation confirmed but have not gone through the full pipeline (Phase 1b harvest-crossref.py + normalize-affiliations.py don't exist yet). See data/reports/iedm-2022-2026-07-19.md and data/reports/iedm-10year-2026-07-19.md.

IEEE+Optica joint. ISSN 1558-2213. Crossref verified 2016-2025: range 816-1356, avg 999. Q1 Optics IF 4.8. High volume — tiering candidate. OpenAlex-verified 2026-07-19: S2307745 confirmed sole/correct source (identity, ISSN, host org IEEE all match; no duplicate/lookalike source found via /sources search on name+acronym). Full year coverage 1983-2026 (2026 partial, in progress), no gaps 2000-2025. Recent volume in-band: 2024=1114, 2025=1073 (both within registry's [816,1356] expected range), though OpenAlex counts run ~3-21% below the existing Crossref-sourced years{} counts for the same years (widens toward present, e.g. 2025: 1073 OpenAlex vs 1356 Crossref) — ruled out duplicate-source and type-filter causes; likely OpenAlex ingestion lag for the newest year, not a wrong-ID signal. Affiliation coverage 93.8% (198/211, n=25 sampled 2024 works), passes 85% threshold. Top-5y institution mix (CAS, BUPT, HUST, Fudan, SJTU, Zhejiang, Tsinghua, NTT Japan, ...) matches known photonics/optical-comms leaders, no anomalies. Open question for a future session: whether to switch this journal's harvest source from the existing per-year Crossref fallback to direct OpenAlex harvesting via S2307745 + publication_year filter, since OpenAlex now independently confirms full coverage for all in-window years.

Optica Publishing Group flagship. ISSN 2334-2536. Crossref verified 2016-2025: range 193-275, avg 237. IF 8.8 (Q1 Optics #12). Gold OA. Began 2014. OpenAlex verification (2026-07-19): identity confirmed against S4210197940 (host org 'Optica Publishing Group', ISSN 2334-2536 match, in-scope sample titles); ruled out lookalikes incl. sibling journal 'Optica Quantum' (separate ISSN 2837-6714). Native OpenAlex year coverage 2014-2026 with no gaps, tracking Crossref counts within single digits every year. Volume sanity passes (2023-2025 within expected_per_year). Institution sniff test passes (CAS, DOE, CNRS, Stanford, Max Planck, ETH domain, USTC, Helmholtz, NIST). BLOCKED from 'verified': affiliation coverage only ~51% (202/395 authorships, 50-paper sample 2023-2024) vs. 85% checklist bar — many unresolved authorships also have empty raw_affiliation_strings (whole affiliation blocks missing, not just unresolved text), a structural OpenAlex gap for this venue. Recommend a future session check whether Crossref affiliation strings have better coverage; if so prefer harvest_crossref.py over native OpenAlex works for this venue.

Optica-hosted, DOI prefix 10.1364/cleo_{at,qels,si}. Single stable series source S4306418073 covers 2016-2022 (no per-year fragmentation, unlike ISSCC/IEDM/DAC). 2023-2025 missing from OpenAlex (works exist with raw_source_name='CLEO 20XX' but primary_location.source is null — not a normal 2yr ingestion lag, it's an unlinked-source gap) — confirmed in Crossref via DOI prefix 10.1364/cleo_ + container-title match: 1704 (2023), 1907 (2024), 1553 (2025). 3 tracks (A&T/QELS-FS/S&I) are NOT separate OpenAlex sources, only DOI sub-prefixes. CLEO-PR and CLEO/Europe confirmed separate (different DOI namespace 10.1109/cleo-pr vs 10.1364/cleo_, zero contamination found in S4306418073 sample). Volume 1553-2710/yr, 2019 ~35% over expected_per_year upper bound of 2000 — flag for tier-placement decision, not resolved here. Affiliation coverage 86.4-99.5% (sampled 2016/2019/2022). status=candidate pending Phase 1b harvest_crossref.py/normalize_affiliations.py for the 2023-2025 years; can likely move to verified once those exist and years are harvested, without redoing source resolution.
